verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items mention HRIS/payroll integrations (e.g., Gusto, Rippling) or any syncing of new hires/terminations into equity records; all evidence covers cap table management, fundraising, SAFEs, and 409A valuations. Missing for 10: any mention of HRIS/payroll integration, automated employee data sync, or third-party connectors for onboarding/termination events.
